description: Fail-loud test-suite dependency mechanism: centralized probe helper, preflight failing test, named lane waivers, per-lane skip-count ratchet (mechanism half of CAM-424; dead-gate sweep split to CAM-432)

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms verbatim 'If a test fails, the test runner exits with a non-zero exit code' (the only documented exit guarantee, matching AC13's local citation of node_modules/bun-types/docs/test/index.mdx:64). --preload exists but the docs give NO guarantee that a throw in preload aborts the run non-zero, confirming the plain-failing-test preflight route. --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile is documented for machine-readable counts the ratchet parser can consume.

docker exec --env/-e is documented to set additional environment variables 'for the process started by docker exec', scoped to that exec'd process only, independent of TTY mode. Sufficient and correct for injecting the per-run container-lane waiver; no documented exit-code caveat for non-interactive exec.

userStories.title: Create centralized dependency-probe helper with classification and waiver semantics
userStories.description: As a test-suite maintainer, I need one tracked module that probes each external binary once, classifies each dependency as hard-dependency or legitimate-environmental, and reads an explicit named waiver declaration, so that dependency handling becomes centralized, visible and falsifiable instead of 46 scattered silent predicates.
acceptanceCriteria: A new tracked module test/helpers/test-deps.ts exports, for each binary in {tmux, git, jq, pgrep, ps, uuidgen, bun}: a once-probed availability boolean, the dependency's classification (hard-dependency vs legitimate-environmental), and a waiver reader over an explicit env var named CAM_TEST_WAIVERS (comma-separated binary names). Change-detecting oracle, red on main (file absent). [oracle: grep -q 'CAM_TEST_WAIVERS' test/helpers/test-deps.ts]

A pure preflight-decision function (DI seam for injected absence, mirroring codexAuthPreflight's destructure-default pattern) is covered by behavioral seam tests in a tracked test file: injected absence of a hard dependency with NO waiver yields a failure decision whose message names that binary with an actionable install hint; the same injected absence WITH the waiver declared yields skip-allowed. This is the AC7 replacement for the v1 tautological grep; DI-injected absence is ADR-0039-compliant here because the real-I/O route is unavailable for /usr/bin binaries. [oracle: bun test test/helpers/test-deps.test.ts]

The ps legitimate-environmental rationale (absent in oven/bun:1.2-slim; the production recycle-watcher runs on the host) is carried into the helper's classification data so it survives the later migration of test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts. [oracle: grep -qi 'oven/bun' test/helpers/test-deps.ts]

No file outside test/helpers/ is created or modified by this story (porcelain form, which unlike git diff sees untracked files; scripts/cam/ state files are exempt). [oracle: test -z "$(git status --porcelain | awk '{print $NF}' | grep -vE '^(test/helpers/|scripts/cam/)')"]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes per AC11. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New files only: test/helpers/test-deps.ts + test/helpers/test-deps.test.ts (test files under test/helpers/ are collected by bun test; precedent test/helpers/with-fake-clock.test.ts). The module MUST live under test/helpers/ because AC1/AC2's centralization greps carry the filter `grep -vE 'test/helpers/|test/fixtures/'`. Probe once at module load (version-flag spawnSync or Bun.which), never per-test. Design the decision fn pure with authoritative inputs injected ({available, waivers}), default-wired to the real probe/env read via destructure defaults, exactly like codexAuthPreflight (src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts, see patterns.md CAM-352 bullets). Do NOT touch the DI-fake option-name sites test/run.test.ts:82 and test/stop.test.ts:58, and nothing under test/fixtures/version-skip-guard/**. tmux install-hint text must enforce the documented policy at scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md:36 (tmux is a hard runtime dependency), not invent a new one.

userStories.title: Add fail-loud preflight as a plain failing test per hard dependency
userStories.description: As a contributor running the suite on a host missing a hard dependency, I need bun test to exit non-zero with an actionable message naming the missing binary, so a partial run can never present as green.
acceptanceCriteria: A new tracked test file test/preflight-deps.test.ts contains one ordinary test per hard dependency that FAILS with an actionable message (binary name + install hint) when that binary is absent and the lane declares no waiver, and passes when the binary is present or waived. Per AC13: do NOT implement as a throw in a [test].preload module, do NOT rely on filename sort order, and do NOT create bunfig.toml anywhere (no criterion in this PRD may be conditioned on bunfig.toml existing). [oracle: test -f test/preflight-deps.test.ts && ! test -f bunfig.toml && grep -q 'brew install tmux' test/preflight-deps.test.ts]

AC3 defining real-I/O oracle (change-detecting, swept exit=0 with 5597 pass / 37 skip on unmodified main): derive the environment, never hardcode Cellar paths: BUNBIN=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v bun)")") then env -i HOME="$HOME" TERM="$TERM" PATH="$BUNBIN:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" bun test must exit NON-ZERO with output naming tmux and how to install it. An exit 0 under this exact command is a FAILED criterion no matter how many tests passed. [oracle: named-command above, echo exit=$? must be non-zero]

AC4 controls: full-PATH bun test reports 0 fail, NO skip summary line, exit 0, and a parsed pass count not below main's floor, derived live from a clean main worktree run (git worktree add), never frozen as a literal in this criterion. PATH-surgery inertness control: the same env -i line WITH the tmux directory prepended (derived via command -v tmux + readlink -f + dirname) matches the full-PATH result exactly, proving any AC3 divergence is caused by this change, not the surgery. [oracle: named-command bun test + the two derived env -i runs]

The preflight tests themselves are unit-covered through the US-001 DI seam (absent+unwaived fails naming the binary; absent+waived passes; present passes). [oracle: bun test test/preflight-deps.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes per AC11. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001's helper. Route rationale (AC13, measured): no bunfig.toml exists in the repo, package.json:11 is plain 'bun test', preload-throw abort semantics are undocumented (re-confirmed via the Bun docs fetch in officialDocsConsulted), and collection order is undocumented; the ONLY documented exit guarantee is that a failing test exits non-zero, which a plain failing test satisfies with no ordering assumption. Fail-fast speed would be the only benefit of ordering tricks and is a cost concern, explicitly not a reason to prefer undocumented mechanisms. Hard-vs-waivable at this point: on the host lane no waiver is permitted; ps stays skippable only under a declared waiver (AC9 rationale in helper). tmux is the only genuinely separable binary for real-I/O proof (git/jq/pgrep/ps/uuidgen live in /usr/bin or /bin; creating symlinks to simulate absence is forbidden). ADR-0039 section on real I/O at wire boundaries governs why the AC3 proof must be a real PATH-surgery run, not a mock.

userStories.title: Add lane-expectations file and per-lane skip-count ratchet gate
userStories.description: As the gate spine, I need a versioned per-lane expectations file (expected skip count, pass floor, triage counts) asserted by a ratchet gate wired into check:all, so any future silent skip breaks the gate and the triage evidence lives on a durable tracked surface instead of rotating harness state.
acceptanceCriteria: A new tracked file test/helpers/lane-expectations.json records, per lane (host, container): expectedSkips and passFloor; plus a triage block with the AC9 per-category counts of the probe-bearing files (hardDependency vs legitimateEnvironmental). This TRACKED file is the durable record for the triage evidence: no oracle in this PRD targets scripts/cam/handoff.json, scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt, or any per-story rotating harness artifact (patterns.md:907/:938). Change-detecting oracle, red on main (file absent). [oracle: bun -e "const j=require('./test/helpers/lane-expectations.json'); if (typeof j.lanes.host.expectedSkips!=='number'||typeof j.lanes.host.passFloor!=='number'||typeof j.lanes.container.expectedSkips!=='number'||typeof j.triage.hardDependency!=='number'||typeof j.triage.legitimateEnvironmental!=='number') process.exit(1)"]
The same per-file classification and per-category counts are also stated in the PR body for reviewer inspection. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A new ratchet gate script scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts parses the suite result for the current lane (junit reporter output or stdout summary), treats a MISSING skip summary line as ZERO (parser constraint, swept: bun test omits the ' N skip' line entirely at zero), compares the observed skip count to the lane's recorded expectation, and fails with a message naming the delta. Unit tests in a tracked test file cover: missing-line-as-zero, exact-match pass, and a +1 delta failure whose message names the delta. [oracle: bun test test/check-skip-ratchet.test.ts]

The ratchet is wired into the gate spine: a package.json script exists, scripts/check-all.ts runs it, and gates-manifest coherence (test/gates-manifest.test.ts) plus check:ci-parity stay green INSIDE check:all (AC11: this story touches the GATES manifest, so stopping at typecheck+test would miss its own regression). [oracle: bun run check:all]

The host lane's recorded passFloor equals the measured full-PATH pass count on this branch and expectedSkips is 0 (the lane file's own recorded values are the ONE place a frozen literal belongs, per AC4's derive-don't-freeze rule; the container lane's expectedSkips may carry a provisional value here and is measured and finalized in US-006). [oracle: full-PATH bun test summary matches the values recorded in test/helpers/lane-expectations.json]

AC6 demonstration EXECUTED, not reasoned: temporarily add one test.skipIf(true) case in a scratch test file, run the gate, observe FAILURE naming the +1 delta; remove the scratch file, observe the gate pass. Do not commit the scratch file (working tree clean of it at commit). Both observations reported verbatim in the PR body. [oracle: reviewer-judgment on the two verbatim observations, plus git status --porcelain shows no scratch test file at commit time]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: test/helpers/lane-expectations.json (new), scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts (new), test/check-skip-ratchet.test.ts (new), scripts/check-all.ts + package.json (wiring). Lane detection: host is the default; the container lane is selected by the same explicit declaration mechanism as the waiver (env), never by sniffing. To avoid double-running the suite inside check:all, the docs fetch confirms bun test --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile emits machine-readable counts alongside normal stdout; parsing the existing test step's output is acceptable, a second full suite run is also acceptable (operational cost is not a criterion). The ratchet counts TESTS, not skipIf sites. gates-manifest test enforces check-all/package.json/ci.yml coherence, and check:ci-parity enforces green-local==green-CI; both live inside check:all. patterns.md:903 derive-don't-freeze governs every floor comparison outside the lane file itself.
